subject: Re: Kickoff: node-level DP GNNs for interaction-graph features
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing: Maren 50% on the DP-GCN training and the epsilon sweeps, Emeka 40% on the interaction-subgraph extraction and anonymization, Bilal 30% on eval tooling and the utility metrics.

Compute is light -- these graphs fit on single hosts, a few Titan A100s best-effort.

Data timeline is the real planning constraint. The interaction subgraph and both benchmark graphs get ingested through Corpus, and the pipelines we build now need to be re-run once on migrated v2 storage. The Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-07-24, which gives us headroom to re-ingest ogbn-arxiv and the reddit-disjoint graph through mid-July. Emeka will schedule the v2 re-ingest for the week of July 13 so we hit the freeze window with everything already staged.

Also queuing the Privacy Review with Kofi's team early -- their SLA is 2-3 weeks and we should not discover that in June.

Deshawn
